item.text: {"rule":"The procedure used two filtering steps: after I tapped two cards, it either kept that pair or discarded it; after I tapped one of the remaining two, it either kept that card or kept the other. These keep/discard decisions varied across rounds, so the observations do not reveal a fixed rule predicting them."}
